summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Kolibri Global Energy Inc., a foreign private issuer, providing a strategy update and higher 2026 operational forecast. The filing announces plans to target additional benches in its Tishomingo field and adds one well to the 2026 drilling program. It includes revised production and financial forecasts but does not involve any merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, restructuring, or other special situation. The update is a standard operational and strategic communication to shareholders.
